name: dashsidian
description: Dashboard blocks for your notes: tiles, number cards, progress bars, a day row, countdowns and a year heatmap. Configured in YAML, no JavaScript.
author: Dmitriy Yurkin (Dimagious)

scripts.build: npm run build:css && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=main.js --minify --platform=browser --format=cjs --target=es2020 --external:obsidian --external:electron --external:@codemirror/state --external:@codemirror/view --footer:js="module.exports = module.exports.default || module.exports;" && node scripts/assert-bundle.cjs
scripts.release:check: node scripts/version-sync.cjs && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm run release:zip
scripts.firstrun: npm run build && node scripts/newcomer-vault.cjs && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE FIRSTRUN=1 DASHY_VAULT=.capture/newcomer playwright test e2e/firstrun.spec.ts --reporter=list
